1: -module(quod_peer_observation_SUITE).
    2: -include_lib("common_test/include/ct.hrl").
    3: -export([all/0, init_per_suite/1, end_per_suite/1,
    4:          cold_timeout_is_shared_physical_suspicion/1,
    5:          contact_survives_consumer_restart_and_expiry/1,
    6:          newer_contact_fences_same_key_history/1,
    7:          withdrawal_fences_pending_physical_completion/1]).
    8: 
    9: all() -> [cold_timeout_is_shared_physical_suspicion,
   10:           contact_survives_consumer_restart_and_expiry,
   11:           newer_contact_fences_same_key_history,
   12:           withdrawal_fences_pending_physical_completion].
   13: 
   14: init_per_suite(Config) -> quod_quic_SUITE:init_per_suite(Config).
   15: end_per_suite(Config) -> quod_quic_SUITE:end_per_suite(Config).
   16: 
   17: cold_timeout_is_shared_physical_suspicion(_Config) ->
   18:     T = quod_reg:where({transport, node}),
   19:     Key = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
   20:     {Socket, Endpoint} = blackhole(),
   21:     Host = install_contact(Key, Endpoint, 1, hosted),
   22:     true = quod_reg:subscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, Host}),
   23:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({peer_loss, Key}),
   24:     Since = quod_time:mono_ms(),
   25:     try
   26:         {ok, Contact} = contact(T, Host),
   27:         Snapshot = quod_quic:peer_connections(T, Key),
   28:         receive {Snapshot, {peer_connections, T, _, Key, []}} -> ok
   29:         after 1000 -> ct:fail(cold_peer_already_authenticated) end,
   30:         {Episode, waiting, none} = observation(T, Contact, Since),
   31:         Parent = self(),
   32:         {Consumer, Monitor} = spawn_monitor(fun() ->
   33:             true = quod_reg:subscribe({peer_loss, Key}),
   34:             Parent ! {second_snapshot, self(), observation(T, Contact, Since)},
   35:             Parent ! {second_observation, self(), completion(T, Key, Episode)}
   36:         end),
   37:         receive {second_snapshot, Consumer, {Episode, waiting, none}} -> ok
   38:         after 1000 -> ct:fail(physical_probe_not_shared) end,
   39:         %% A real QUIC Initial proves that missing prior coverage was not used
   40:         %% as failure evidence; suspicion requires this attempt to time out.
   41:         _ = initial(Socket, quod_time:mono_ms() + 4000),
   42:         {suspected_unreachable, At} = completion(T, Key, Episode),
   43:         receive {second_observation, Consumer, {suspected_unreachable, At}} -> ok
   44:         after 1000 -> ct:fail(physical_completion_not_shared) end,
   45:         receive {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Consumer, normal} -> ok
   46:         after 1000 -> ct:fail(consumer_not_finished) end,
   47:         {Episode, suspected_unreachable, At} = observation(T, Contact, Since),
   48:         %% A notice captured before a new dependency can only wake it. Its
   49:         %% snapshot must request new physical work, not reuse the old result.
   50:         {Fresh, waiting, none} = observation(T, Contact, quod_time:mono_ms()),
   51:         true = Fresh =/= Episode
   52:     after
   53:         quod_reg:unsubscribe({peer_loss, Key}),
   54:         quod_reg:unsubscribe_tracked({node_identity_route, Host}),
   55:         gen_udp:close(Socket)
   56:     end.
   57: 
   58: withdrawal_fences_pending_physical_completion(_Config) ->
   59:     T = quod_reg:where({transport, node}),
   60:     Key = crypto:strong_rand_bytes(32),
   61:     {Socket, Endpoint} = blackhole(),
   62:     Host = install_contact(Key, Endpoint, 1, hosted),
   63:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({peer_loss, Key}),
   64:     try
   65:         {ok, Contact} = contact(T, Host),
   66:         {Episode, waiting, none} = observation(T, Contact, quod_time:mono_ms()),
   67:         _ = initial(Socket, quod_time:mono_ms() + 4000),
   68:         Host = install_contact(Key, Endpoint, 2, withdrawn),
   69:         false = quod_directory:node_contact_current(Contact),
   70:         {{unknown, stale_contact}, _} = completion(T, Key, Episode),
   71:         unknown = contact(T, Host)
   72:     after
   73:         quod_reg:unsubscribe({peer_loss, Key}),
   74:         gen_udp:close(Socket)
   75:     end.
   76: 
   77: contact_survives_consumer_restart_and_expiry(Config) ->
   78:     T = quod_reg:where({transport, node}),
   79:     Key = ?config(self_pubkey, Config),
   80:     {ok, Endpoint} = application:get_env(quod, node_addr),
   81:     Host = install_contact(Key, Endpoint, 1, hosted),
   82:     Parent = self(),
   83:     {Consumer, Monitor} = spawn_monitor(fun() ->
   84:         true = quod_reg:subscribe({peer_loss, Key}),
   85:         {ok, Contact0} = contact(T, Host),
   86:         {Episode0, waiting, none} = observation(T, Contact0, quod_time:mono_ms()),
   87:         {reachable, _} = completion(T, Key, Episode0),
   88:         Parent ! {acquired_contact, self(), Contact0, Episode0}
   89:     end),
   90:     {Contact, Episode} = receive
   91:         {acquired_contact, Consumer, C, E} -> {C, E}
   92:     after 8000 -> ct:fail(contact_not_acquired) end,
   93:     receive {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Consumer, normal} -> ok
   94:     after 1000 -> ct:fail(first_consumer_not_finished) end,
   95:     ok = quod_directory:expire(maps:get(expiry, Contact)),
   96:     unknown = quod_directory:node_transport_route(Host),
   97:     true = quod_directory:node_contact_current(Contact),
   98:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({peer_loss, Key}),
   99:     try
  100:         {ok, Contact} = contact(T, Host),
  101:         {Fresh, waiting, none} = observation(T, Contact, quod_time:mono_ms()),
  102:         true = Fresh =/= Episode,
  103:         {reachable, _} = completion(T, Key, Fresh),
  104:         %% Only the transport owns retention. Replacing that owner cannot
  105:         %% reacquire an expired route from another consumer's old reference.
  106:         Sup = quod_reg:where({sup, node}),
  107:         ok = supervisor:terminate_child(Sup, quod_quic),
  108:         {ok, NextT} = supervisor:restart_child(Sup, quod_quic),
  109:         true = NextT =/= T,
  110:         unknown = contact(NextT, Host),
  111:         Ref = quod_quic:confirm_peer_loss(NextT, Contact, quod_time:mono_ms()),
  112:         receive {Ref, {unknown, route_unavailable}} -> ok
  113:         after 1000 -> ct:fail(old_owner_contact_was_reacquired) end
  114:     after quod_reg:unsubscribe({peer_loss, Key}) end.
  115: 
  116: newer_contact_fences_same_key_history(Config) ->
  117:     T = quod_reg:where({transport, node}),
  118:     {Peer, Key, Endpoint} = quod_agent_peer:start(
  119:         filename:join(?config(priv_dir, Config), "generation-peer")),
  120:     {Socket, SilentEndpoint} = blackhole(),
  121:     Host = install_contact(Key, Endpoint, 1, hosted),
  122:     true = quod_reg:subscribe({peer_loss, Key}),
  123:     try
  124:         {ok, First} = contact(T, Host),
  125:         {Healthy, waiting, none} = observation(T, First, quod_time:mono_ms()),
  126:         {reachable, _} = completion(T, Key, Healthy),
  127:         Host = install_contact(Key, SilentEndpoint, 2, hosted),
  128:         Ref = quod_quic:confirm_peer_loss(T, First, quod_time:mono_ms()),
  129:         receive {Ref, {unknown, route_unavailable}} -> ok
  130:         after 1000 -> ct:fail(old_generation_was_not_fenced) end,
  131:         {ok, Second} = contact(T, Host),
  132:         SilentEndpoint = maps:get(endpoint, Second),
  133:         {Pending, waiting, none} = observation(T, Second, quod_time:mono_ms()),
  134:         %% The earlier endpoint still authenticates the SAME key. Only the
  135:         %% current endpoint's actual completion can satisfy this dependency.
  136:         _ = initial(Socket, quod_time:mono_ms() + 4000),
  137:         {suspected_unreachable, _} = completion(T, Key, Pending),
  138:         Host = install_contact(Key, SilentEndpoint, 3, withdrawn),
  139:         unknown = contact(T, Host),
  140:         Withdrawn = quod_quic:confirm_peer_loss(T, Second, quod_time:mono_ms()),
  141:         receive {Withdrawn, {unknown, route_unavailable}} -> ok
  142:         after 1000 -> ct:fail(withdrawal_did_not_fence_retained_contact) end,
  143:         Host = install_contact(Key, Endpoint, 4, hosted),
  144:         {ok, Third} = contact(T, Host),
  145:         Sup = quod_reg:where({sup, node}),
  146:         ok = supervisor:terminate_child(Sup, quod_directory),
  147:         {ok, _} = supervisor:restart_child(Sup, quod_directory),
  148:         false = quod_directory:node_contact_current(Third),
  149:         unknown = contact(T, Host)
  150:     after
  151:         quod_reg:unsubscribe({peer_loss, Key}),
  152:         gen_udp:close(Socket),
  153:         quod_agent_peer:stop(Peer)
  154:     end.
  155: 
  156: blackhole() ->
  157:     {ok, Socket} = gen_udp:open(0, [binary, {active, false}]),
  158:     {ok, Port} = inet:port(Socket),
  159:     {Socket, {"127.0.0.1", Port}}.
  160: 
  161: install_contact(Key, Endpoint, Generation, Kind) ->
  162:     Ns = <<"observation-test:", (binary:encode_hex(Key))/binary>>,
  163:     Anchor = crypto:hash(sha256, Ns),
  164:     Host = {agent_instance_ref, Ns, Anchor, physical_node},
  165:     {ok, Blob} = quod_wire_term:encode_canonical(Host),
  166:     Hosted = case Kind of hosted -> [{Ns, Anchor, observer, node}]; withdrawn -> [] end,
  167:     {ok, _} = quod_directory:install_generation(
  168:         #{author => {node_actor, Blob}, node_key => Key, endpoint => Endpoint,
  169:           epoch => 1, generation => Generation, page => 0, last => true, hosted => Hosted}),
  170:     Host.
  171: 
  172: contact(T, Host) ->
  173:     Ref = quod_quic:peer_contact(T, Host),
  174:     receive {Ref, {peer_contact, T, Host, Result}} -> Result
  175:     after 1000 -> ct:fail(no_contact_snapshot) end.
  176: 
  177: observation(T, #{node_key := Key} = Contact, Since) ->
  178:     Ref = quod_quic:confirm_peer_loss(T, Contact, Since),
  179:     receive {Ref, {peer_loss, T, Key, Episode, Status, At}} -> {Episode, Status, At}
  180:     after 1000 -> ct:fail(no_observation_snapshot) end.
  181: 
  182: completion(T, Key, Episode) ->
  183:     receive
  184:         {peer_loss, T, Key, Episode, Status, At} when is_integer(At) -> {Status, At}
  185:     after 8000 -> ct:fail(no_physical_completion) end.
  186: 
  187: initial(Socket, Deadline) ->
  188:     case gen_udp:recv(Socket, 0, max(0, Deadline - quod_time:mono_ms())) of
  189:         {ok, {_, _, <<1:1, 1:1, 0:2, _:4, 1:32, Length:8, Cid:Length/binary, _/binary>>}} -> Cid;
  190:         {ok, _} -> initial(Socket, Deadline);
  191:         {error, Reason} -> ct:fail({no_actual_connection_attempt, Reason})
  192:     end.
